# 𝙈𝙚𝙡𝙤𝙙𝙞𝙓 🎧 <img src="https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/TheY_CaIl_mE_OG/MelodiXMusicBot?color=black&logo=github&logoColor=black&style=social" alt="RELEASE">

[𝙈𝙚𝙡𝙤𝙙𝙞𝙓 🎧](the private Melody repository) is a Powerful Telegram Music+Video Bot written in Python using Pyrogram and Py-Tgcalls by which you can stream songs, video and even live streams in your group calls via various sources.

[![Deploy to Heroku](https://www.herokucdn.com/deploy/button.svg)](https://heroku.com/deploy?template=https://github.com/oyevipthoma88/Melody_music)

* Youtube, Soundcloud, Apple Music, Spotify, Resso, Live Streams and Telegram Audios & Videos support.
* Written from scratch, making it stable and less crashes with attractive thumbnails.
* Loop, Seek, Shuffle, Specific Skip, Playlists etc support
* Multi-Language support


# ⚡️ Getting Started [[Documentation](https://notreallyshikhar.gitbook.io/melodixmusicbot/)]
